Function: calculateFinishTimes
Purpose: To calculate and print the finish time for each person purchasing a ticket at a booth, given their arrival times and the time taken to purchase a ticket.
Signature: calculateFinishTimes()
Input:
  - User input via Scanner:
    - An integer `N` representing the number of people.
    - An integer `A` representing the time taken to purchase a ticket.

  4. Read an array `T` of `N` integers from the user, representing the arrival times.
  5. Initialize a variable `lastFinishTime` to 0 to track the finish time of the last person.
  6. Iterate over each arrival time `T[i]`:
     a. If `T[i]` is greater than `lastFinishTime`, set `finishTime` to `T[i] + A`.
     b. Otherwise, set `finishTime` to `lastFinishTime + A`.
     c. Update `lastFinishTime` to `finishTime`.
     d. Print `finishTime`.
